value.syntax: # [doc = " Bytes or a value refused as a document, or a prefix too short to carry"] # [doc = " an envelope."] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " ```"] # [doc = " use pn_interchange::{EnvelopeError, Value, Version};"] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " let err = Version::from_value(&Value::Unsigned(3)).expect_err(\"not a triple\");"] # [doc = " assert!(matches!(err, EnvelopeError::BadVersion));"] # [doc = " ```"] # [derive (Debug , thiserror :: Error)] # [non_exhaustive] pub enum EnvelopeError { # [doc = " The prefix ended before the envelope did."] # [error ("prefix of {given} bytes is too short to carry an envelope")] Truncated { # [doc = " How many bytes were offered."] given : usize , # [doc = " The least number of bytes that would let the read that ran out"] # [doc = " complete. What follows that read may need more still."] needed_at_least : usize , } , # [doc = " The value is not a map, so it is not a document."] # [error ("document is not a map")] NotAMap , # [doc = " A key outside the unsigned integers, which the key space excludes."] # [error ("key {key} is not an unsigned integer")] NonIntegerKey { # [doc = " A rendering of the offending key: its debug form where the key"] # [doc = " was decoded whole, its major type where only a head was read."] key : String , } , # [doc = " One of the two envelope keys is absent."] # [error ("key {key} is missing")] MissingKey { # [doc = " The key that is missing: 0 or 1."] key : u64 , } , # [doc = " Key 0 holds a text string that is not a namespace label."] # [error ("key 0 does not hold a namespace label")] BadLabel (# [source] LabelError) , # [doc = " Key 0 holds something that is not a text string at all."] # [error ("key 0 does not hold a text string")] BadLabelType , # [doc = " Key 1 holds something other than a three-element array of unsigned"] # [doc = " integers."] # [error ("key 1 does not hold a version triple")] BadVersion , # [doc = " A content key of 0 or 1, which the envelope owns."] # [error ("content key {key} is not greater than 1")] ReservedContentKey { # [doc = " The key offered."] key : u64 , } , # [doc = " A head of the envelope prefix that preferred serialization refuses,"] # [doc = " or a label whose bytes are not valid UTF-8."] # [error ("envelope prefix is not canonically encoded at byte {offset}")] NonCanonicalPrefix { # [doc = " Where the offending head or byte stands."] offset : usize , } , # [doc = " Bytes offered as a document that are not a name of the data"] # [doc = " language at all."] # [error ("bytes are not a name of the data language")] NotCanonical (# [source] DecodeError) , }
